已有旧版本连接；上游已变化，等待重新统筹。: An earlier mapping exists, but upstream data changed and requires coordination.

这部分只草拟节点职责与连接，尚未接入本次新工作流。: These nodes propose roles and connections; they are not part of this implementation.
旧版需求以原文摘要作为一个输出端口，未自动改写原结果。: Legacy requirements retain the original summary as one output; the content is not rewritten.
旧版结果还没有结构化功能模块: The legacy result has no structured function modules
保留原文，不把文字事实伪装成功能输出。重新执行意图阶段后，会生成独立的功能端口。: Original text is preserved. Rerunning the intent stage produces separate function ports.
硬件节点接收所有功能输出，检索来源并组合候选器件。: The hardware node consumes function outputs, searches sources, and combines candidates.
